headline: Range Resources agrees to be acquired by EQT, all stock, 0.987 EQT share per RRC share; RRC holders get 27% of the combined company
reasoning: Source: Range's 8-K filed 07:07 ET, item 1.01. Quoted: 'each share of common stock ... of Range ... will be converted into the right to receive, without interest, 0.987 (the "Exchange Ratio") shares of common stock, no par value, of EQT'. Also: 'Range's existing stockholders and EQT's existing stockholders will own approximately 27% and 73%, respectively, of the combined company'.

Approvals: 'unanimously approved by the board of directors of Range and the board of directors of EQT'. Conditions include votes at both companies and no injunction. Benzinga gives expected closing as Q1 2027.

Timing: the first Benzinga report was at 06:03 ET (10:03 UTC), about an hour before the 8-K. Both came before the open, and no session has traded it. There was no earlier rumor in Benzinga's last ten days.
What changed: Range stops being an independent Appalachian gas producer. Its share value is now tied to EQT's share price at a fixed ratio.

Pre-market on IEX: RRC has no prints yet against its 45.535 close. EQT trades at 51.52, -7.4% from 55.62, on 6,327 shares. At that price the ratio is worth 50.85 per RRC share, +11.7%; at Friday's EQT close it was 54.90.
